protocol.constraints: solute X-H bonds plus all three CH2Cl2-DC distances (LINCS)
protocol.concentration_treatment: infinite-dilution single-solute box; no intermolecular MTMR encounters

scientific_boundary: All old GFN-FF/300 K/vacuum trajectories are method controls only.
No old and new trajectory frames may be pooled in one fitted q matrix.
MD estimates state-conditioned conformational contact kernels; reactions remain a separate graph model.
The experimental 3e-5 M concentration is represented as infinite dilution, not by a literal 38 nm one-solute box.
